responseText:
I can do that, but I need a few specifics and your explicit confirmation before I forward anything.

Please reply with the exact choices for each item below:

1) Recipient(s) — provide the exact email address or group alias to forward to (e.g., finance@yourcompany.com). I will not guess or use a generic name.

2) Attachments — choose one:
   - Include all attachments
   - Exclude all attachments
   - Include only these attachments: (list filenames)

3) Scope of thread — choose one:
   - Forward the entire thread (all messages)
   - Forward only the most recent message
   - Forward only messages from [date] to [date] (specify)

4) Cover note (optional) — paste the short message to include at top of the forwarded email, or say “No cover note.”

Warning: forwarding will disclose the selected messages and any included attachments to the recipient(s). That may share confidential financial details or other private info. If that’s acceptable, reply with the items above and then type a final explicit confirmation by replying: “Confirm send.” I will only forward after that confirmation.
